sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch press release (29 Oct 2025): a leaked draft of the 11th Judicial Reform Package would pave the way to criminal charges against LGBT people in the country - described as one of the most alarming rights rollbacks in decades; HRW calls for the draft's immediate withdrawal.

Kaos GL Association's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, titled 'The Year of the Family: A Major Siege Against LGBTI+ People': in 2025 anti-LGBTI policies became institutionalised - instructions to public institutions under the 'Year of the Family' banner, hate speech from senior officials, and religious and administrative rhetoric creating a climate that encouraged human-rights violations; monitoring since 2007, based on media reports and applications submitted to the association.
